name: Welcome
description: Sent once the account is confirmed, to orient a new user and point at a first useful action.

origin.note: Structure follows the Postmark welcome template (MIT, Wildbit); visual design and markup are this package's own.

subject: Welcome to {{ product.name }}
preheader: Here's how to get your first result in the next few minutes.

body.default: Thanks for signing up. Your account is ready, and the fastest way to see what this does is to start with one of the steps below.

steps.description: First actions worth taking. Keep to three or fewer; a longer list reads as homework.

example.detail: Collaboration is where this gets useful
Confirm everything works end to end

account_details.description: Reference details worth restating, e.g. the login address and plan.

closing.default: If anything looks off, just reply to this email -- it reaches a person.
